title: How do you feel when you dream with these places?

classification.theory_summary: Author suggests the places may be other dimensions perceived through the pineal gland during dreams.
classification.question_topic: Asks how others feel when they dream of these places; shares their own affective tone (nostalgic, weird, almost uncomfortable).
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene(s) or locations described beyond 'same places'; no extractable location/connection/boundary events.

meta.author_theory: Pretty convinced theyre other dimensions and we can see them through our pinneal gland in dreams.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenology present is limited to recurrence ('since I was a teenager', 'always the same places but different situations') and affective tone ('nostalgic', 'weird', 'almost uncomfortable'). No concrete place-descriptions, sensory details (light, cleanliness, crowds), movements, or events were provided.
